Face: sun-browned skin; one ear sticking out more than the other. The eyes of ordinary size for the face. A plain, homely, lived-in face, as rough and ordinary as any man's, her clothes practical and closed up to the collarbone. The first fine lines at the corners of the eyes, a settled adult face. Downcast, heavy eyes and a drawn, tired mouth. She wears a scuffed jumpsuit patched at the knees and elbows. A hard-worn, weather-beaten face. Facing front. Clearly in her early forties. Clearly a neanderthal, with the massive brow ridge, the low, sloping forehead, the broad, flat nose and the chinless jaw.
pose: The head lowered a little, the shoulders sagging.

name: p_darkelf_f_young_char_white_black_02
subject: A young dark elf woman in her mid-twenties, clearly a grown adult: long, pointed elven ears sweeping back past the head, a narrow, bony face with high, sharp cheekbones, a long, straight nose, a narrow chin, an oddly ageless face, white, almost porcelain skin, long black hair, one side shaved to the scalp, of middling build. Face: a few faint blemishes; a big overbite. A sour, down-turned mouth. The eyes of ordinary size for the face. A plain, homely, lived-in face, as rough and ordinary as any man's, her clothes practical and closed up to the collarbone. An adult face, firm skin, no lines yet. She wears a laced bodice over a linen shift, a wooden bead necklace. A plain, everyday look. In short, a sullen, young dark elf woman. Facing front. Clearly in her mid-twenties. Clearly a dark elf, with the long, pointed elven ears.
pose: The head lowered, looking up from under the brows.

name: p_hussar_m_young_drinker_veryfair_blond_01
subject: A young hussar man in his early twenties, clearly a grown adult: vivid red eyes, the red irises plain to see, a hard, alert, watchful stare, thick, tough, weathered skin, a muscular soldier's neck and shoulders, very fair skin, a shaved head with a day of stubble on the scalp, a pointed blond goatee, heavily muscled. Face: a pear-shaped face, wide at the jaw; a single thick brow. The eyes of ordinary size for the face. An adult face, firm skin, no lines yet. A red, bulbous nose, flushed cheeks with fine broken veins and tired, watery eyes. He wears a scarf wound high round the neck over a wool tunic. Chapped lips and wind-reddened cheeks. In short, a brawny, young hussar man. Facing front. Clearly in his early twenties. Clearly a hussar, with the vivid red eyes and the hard soldier's stare.
pose: A battered tankard held loosely at chest height.
